t: AI-Generated Refactoring Advice from Top LLM Models
s: This article explores AI-driven refactoring advice, focusing on the FastHTML Python web framework's capabilities for modernizing code. It highlights FastHTML's idiomatic Python-HTML mapping, database integration via MiniDataAPI, and built-in WebSocket support for real-time features.
sub: FastHTML Framework: Pythonic HTML, Flask-like structure, no Jinga/JSX.
MiniDataAPI & CRUD: Streamlined database operations (Create, Read, Delete) within FastHTML.
WebSockets in FastHTML: Enabling real-time, bidirectional communication and long-running task streaming.
Contextual Filtering with .xtra(): Multi-tenant data isolation and query context management in MiniDataAPI.
